fields.display_title: We thank the reviewers for their helpful comments. TDformer uses frequency-domain attention but does not fuse time and frequency, as its branches never interact. Our model explicitly enables such interaction via cross-domain attention, adaptive decomposition, and contrastive regularization, and we follow standard unified lookback settings to ensure fair comparison and avoid tuning bias.
